description: Acqua - Area sottoposta a pericolo idrogeologico is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by arcgis.com. La Legge regionale 7 agosto 2007 n. 4 riconosce l?importanza naturalistica ed ambientale nonchè l?interesse culturale, scientifico e turistico delle grotte e delle aree carsiche esistenti sul proprio territorio e promuove ogni iniziativa diretta alla loro conoscenza, conservazione e valorizzazione sostiene inoltre lo sviluppo dell?attività speleologica. Coverage: IT. Its keywords include Geology, n.d., Soil, Natural risk zones, Meteorological geographical features, Land use. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2008-01-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
